interpretation_limits: Screenshot is one personalized feed, not all audience exposure.

Views divided by CTR must not be treated as the actual registered impressions count.
25:39 AVD with a downward comparison indicator does not establish strong retention.
Earlier branded identity approval was visual approval, not measured CTR evidence.
Junction is already lighter in text; removal alone has not demonstrated a win.

Retain muted-colour options; test hierarchy/local contrast before blanket saturation or brightness changes.
Use accurate experiential title wording; original destination names support the invitation.
